description: Predict Italian evaluation metrics across published model parameter scales using aggregate results only.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: The response is the source-reported benchmark quantity identified by the `group` label; the law predicts one scalar metric within each group. Representative metric labels are acc norm,none, acc,none, bertscore,none, f1,none, mcc,none, rouge1,none, and 4 more.
